chunks: And by this chain from Sayf ibn 'Umayra from Shu'aib ibn Sawwar from al-Ahnaf ibn Qays from Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (may he have mercy) who said:
There are no two Muslims who have three children pass away before them, who did not seek the break (of the bond), except that Allah will admit them into Paradise by the grace of His mercy.

key_terms.الْحِنْثَ: the break (referring to the bond of parenthood or the parents' desire for their death)
key_terms.بِفَضْلِ رَحْمَتِهِ: by the grace of His mercy
key_terms.يُقَدِّمَانِ: pass away before (children dying before parents)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a Muslim couple who lose three children?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to highlight the specific reward for parents who endure the loss of three children with patience, provided they did not 'seek' (bagha) their premature death through specific acts or intentions. This hadith serves as a source of comfort for those grieving multiple child losses, emphasizing that divine mercy grants Paradise as a direct consequence of their enduring patience and fidelity.
